editorialSummary.heading: Hallsville ISD 2026-2027 calendar highlights
highlights: 170 student days across four nine-week grading periods
Fall Break: October 12–16; students return October 21
Christmas Break: December 21–January 1; students return January 6
Early release at 12:30 p.m.: December 17 and May 27
paragraphs: Hallsville ISD in Hallsville, Texas, uses four nine-week grading periods. Its campus calendar lists 170 student days: 78 in the first semester and 92 in the second. May 27 ends the fourth nine weeks and second semester, making it the last regular student date shown, although the PDF does not print a separate “Last Day of School” label. Graduation is listed for May 28; no ceremony time or venue is given.

Fall Break ends Friday, October 16, but students do not return the following Monday. October 19–20 are Staff Days, so classes resume Wednesday, October 21. Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27. For the Christmas holidays, families need to account for Staff Days on December 18 and January 4–5 as well as the official December 21–January 1 break. Students are off continuously from December 18 through January 5 and return January 6.

Spring Break is March 15–19, with classes resuming March 22. The Good Friday holiday on March 26 and a Staff Day on March 29 create a separate four-day weekend. Testing dates do not identify which students take which exams. The June testing weeks are after the regular student year, while June 1–2 make-up days are for staff.

Texas Virtual Academy at Hallsville publishes its own calendar. Its grading boundaries, some Staff Days, last student date and graduation schedule differ from the Hallsville campus calendar. TVAH families should use the virtual program’s calendar rather than these campus dates.

about.dataSource: Dates come from Hallsville ISD’s currently linked 2026-2027 academic calendar. The downloaded official PDF matches the supplied local file. Its visible approval date is January 20, 2026, and its printed version is V20260120v3. The July 21 date in the filename and PDF metadata is not treated as a separate board approval or a printed revision date. The district’s Back To School page supplies registration and orientation details; its weather procedures supply closure guidance.
about.processing: Official holiday and Staff Day entries remain separate. Derived student breaks combine those entries with adjacent weekends only after checking every weekday. The final regular student date is inferred from the May 27 semester and fourth-nine-weeks endpoints and is marked as derived, not a separately printed Last Day label. Testing symbols are grouped into uninterrupted weekday runs; they do not identify students, grades or subjects. Graduation remains separate from the staff entry on the same date. Staff-only training, staff make-up dates and office-only closures are excluded. The January 1 Christmas Break entry keeps both WINTER_BREAK and HOLIDAY classifications; holiday filtering and statistics use all event classifications, not just the primary type. The weather procedures contain inconsistent bus-pickup wording, so the delayed-start FAQ refers families to the day’s official transportation instructions.
about.updates: This calendar was checked on October 11, 2026. Recheck the district’s calendar link and family announcements for changes to student attendance, early release, testing or graduation. A later school year is published here only after an official source is available.
about.disclaimer: This is an independent calendar guide, not a Hallsville ISD website. The page covers the Hallsville campus calendar, not Texas Virtual Academy at Hallsville. Campus and district announcements take precedence if arrangements change, especially for testing, transportation and graduation.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Hallsville ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students begin Thursday, August 13, 2026. This is the Hallsville campus calendar; Texas Virtual Academy at Hallsville publishes a separate calendar.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Hallsville ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The regular student year ends Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early release at 12:30 p.m. This is the end of the fourth nine weeks and second semester. Graduation is listed for May 28.

faqs.question: How many student days are on the Hallsville ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists 170 student days: 78 in the first semester and 92 in the second. The two early-release dates are still student attendance days.

faqs.question: Do Hallsville ISD students have school on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, is the Labor Day holiday. Classes resume Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville ISD Fall Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Break is October 12–16, 2026. October 19–20 are separate Staff Days with no student classes, so students return Wednesday, October 21. Including the weekends, students are off from October 10 through October 20.

faqs.question: When do students return after Fall Break?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, October 21, 2026. Hallsville ISD’s Fall Break ends October 16, but students do not attend classes on the October 19–20 Staff Days.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville ISD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville ISD Christmas Break, and how long are students off?
faqs.answer: Students have no regular classes from December 18, 2026, through January 5, 2027, and return January 6. The official calendar calls December 21–January 1 Christmas Break; December 18 and January 4–5 are separate Staff Days. December 17 is an early-release school day.

faqs.question: When do students return after Christmas Break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027, which is also the beginning of the second semester and third nine weeks. January 4–5 are Staff Days, not student attendance days.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday.

faqs.question: Are students off for Presidents’ Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027, is the Presidents’ Day holiday. Students are also off Friday, February 12, for a Staff Day, creating a four-day weekend. Classes resume Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville ISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs March 15–19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22, when the fourth nine weeks begins.

faqs.question: Do students have classes on Good Friday or Easter Monday 2027?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, March 26, 2027, for Good Friday and Monday, March 29, for a Staff Day. The calendar does not label March 29 as an Easter holiday. Classes resume Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Which Staff Days have no student classes?
faqs.answer: During Hallsville ISD’s student year, Staff Days are October 19–20 and December 18, 2026, plus January 4–5, February 12 and March 29, 2027. There are no regular student classes on those seven weekdays.

faqs.question: What are Hallsville ISD’s early-release dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students have early release on Thursday, December 17, 2026, and Thursday, May 27, 2027. Both dates are semester-ending school days.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal?
faqs.answer: Hallsville ISD’s calendar gives a 12:30 p.m. release time for December 17, 2026, and May 27, 2027.

faqs.question: What are the nine-week grading periods?
faqs.answer: The first nine weeks runs August 13–October 9; the second, October 21–December 17; the third, January 6–March 12; and the fourth, March 22–May 27.

faqs.question: When do Hallsville ISD semesters end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first semester ends December 17, 2026, and the second ends May 27, 2027. Both dates have early release at 12:30 p.m.

faqs.question: What testing dates are marked on the Hallsville ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks December 1–4 and December 7–11, 2026; April 5–9, 12–16, 19–23 and 26–30, 2027; and June 14–18 and June 21–25, 2027. These are testing dates, not a districtwide requirement for every student to test.

faqs.question: Does every student test on every listed date?
faqs.answer: Hallsville ISD’s annual calendar does not list grades, subjects or individual testing assignments. Use your child’s campus testing schedule to find the dates that apply.

faqs.question: Are testing dates no-school days?
faqs.answer: Testing dates are not listed as student holidays. The June sessions fall after the regular student year, and district/campus offices are scheduled to be closed June 18 and June 25. Check campus instructions for your child’s testing arrangements.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville ISD graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists graduation on Friday, May 28, 2027. It does not give a ceremony time or venue. Hallsville High School announcements will provide those details; TVAH has a separate graduation schedule.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville ISD new student registration for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Pre-K and kindergarten registration is July 28, 2026, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Registration for new students in all grades is July 29 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and July 30 from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.

faqs.question: What should families bring to Hallsville ISD new student registration?
faqs.answer: Bring a lease or rental agreement, or the most recent Harrison County Tax Statement, as proof of residence; utility bills are not accepted. The district also lists the child’s birth certificate, Social Security card and current immunization records; a parent or guardian’s driver’s license or passport; a prior school report card; and any applicable guardianship/legal documents and special-program paperwork.

faqs.question: When does online registration open for returning students?
faqs.answer: Online registration opens Friday, July 17, 2026, at 10 a.m. Parents and guardians complete it through HISD Family Access at family.hisd.com.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville ISD Meet the Teacher in 2026?
faqs.answer: East, North and West Elementary hold Meet the Teacher on August 10 from 5 to 6:30 p.m. Intermediate holds it August 11 from 5 to 6:30 p.m., and Junior High holds it August 11 from 5:30 to 7 p.m.

faqs.question: When is Hallsville High School freshman orientation in 2026?
faqs.answer: The student and parent meeting is Friday, August 7, 2026, from 5 to 6:30 p.m. at the HHS Performing Arts Center.

faqs.question: When is the Hallsville ISD community pep rally in 2026?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists the community pep rally for Thursday, August 6, 2026, from 6 to 8 p.m.

faqs.question: Are June 1–2, 2027, student make-up days in Hallsville ISD?
faqs.answer: No. The annual calendar labels June 1–2 as staff make-up days. They are not scheduled as regular student attendance days. A later weather-related change would need a district announcement.

faqs.question: How does Hallsville ISD announce weather closures?
faqs.answer: Hallsville ISD tries to decide the night before. If that is not possible, its weather procedures call for a decision by 5 a.m. Notices go out through ParentSquare, the district website and social media.

faqs.question: Does Hallsville ISD use delayed starts for severe weather?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district may delay the start of school when conditions allow a safe opening later in the morning. Its weather procedures describe a typical two-hour delay, but the superintendent decides the actual schedule. Check the day’s district notice for school start times and transportation instructions.

faqs.question: Can weather closures change student holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hallsville ISD’s weather procedures say lost instructional time may need to be made up by adding school time or using a scheduled holiday. The annual calendar does not designate specific student weather make-up dates.

faqs.question: Does this Hallsville ISD calendar apply to Texas Virtual Academy at Hallsville?
faqs.answer: No. TVAH publishes its own 2026-2027 academic calendar. Its grading boundaries, some Staff Days, final student date and graduation schedule differ from the Hallsville campus calendar.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Hallsville ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: Hallsville ISD’s District Calendars page links the official 2026-2027 HISD Calendar PDF. Use TVAH’s own Academic Calendar page for the virtual program.
